name: Mexican Fudge
description: A warm, cheesy baked appetizer served on Triscuits.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup taco or salsa sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Grease a 9×11 in pan and spread the cheddar cheese evenly on the bottom.
Lightly beat the eggs and mix with taco or salsa sauce.
Pour the egg mixture over the cheddar cheese.
Top with the shredded mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.
Cut into squares while warm and serve on Triscuits.

keywords: Mexican fudge, baked cheese dip, salsa appetizer, cheesy squares

_similar.name: Nacho Fiesta Dip
_similar.description: A layered dip featuring cottage cheese, cream cheese, and taco seasoning, topped with lettuce, tomatoes, and cheddar cheese.
recipeIngredient: Large bag tortilla chips for serving

recipeInstructions.text: Mix cottage cheese, cream cheese, and taco seasoning together in a blender until well combined.
Place the mixture in a large bowl lined with Saran Wrap and refrigerate covered for 1 hour.
Remove the dip from the bowl by tipping it onto a platter or large plate and peeling off the Saran Wrap.
Cover the dip with shredded lettuce, then diced tomatoes, and finally grated cheddar cheese.
Surround with tortilla chips and serve.

_similar.keywords: layered dip, nacho fiesta, taco seasoning, cheesy dip

_similar.name: Mexican Salad
_similar.description: A hearty and flavorful salad with kidney beans, lentils, and low-fat cheese, topped with salsa and served with taco chips.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup low-fat cheese (mozzarella or cheddar or combination)

recipeInstructions.text: Combine kidney beans, lentils, diced tomato, shredded lettuce, chopped green pepper, low-fat cheese, and green onions in a large bowl.
Toss the salad with Catalina dressing until well coated.
Top the salad with salsa.
Serve immediately with taco chips on the side.

_similar.keywords: Mexican salad, bean salad, taco chips

_similar.name: Nacho Dip
_similar.description: A creamy and flavorful dip made with cream cheese, sour cream, and taco seasoning, topped with salsa, cheese, and chopped vegetables.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine cream cheese, sour cream, and taco seasoning mix until smooth.
Spread the mixture in a large glass pan.
Spread salsa sauce over the cream cheese layer.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the salsa layer.
Add chopped red pepper, green pepper, and tomato on top.
Serve with baked nacho chips.

_similar.keywords: nacho dip, creamy dip, taco seasoning, salsa dip

_similar.name: Jelly Roll Style Meat Loaf
_similar.description: A creative meat loaf recipe shaped like a jelly roll, filled with mozzarella cheese and baked in a loaf pan.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup cracker crumbs or dry bread crumbs

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients except ground beef in a large bowl, using only 1 cup of mozzarella cheese.
Add ground beef and mix thoroughly with hands until just combined.
Shape the mixture into a 10x12 inch rectangle on waxed paper.
Sprinkle 2 cups of mozzarella cheese over the meat.
Roll up the mixture like a jelly roll using the waxed paper and press ends together to seal.
Place the foil-wrapped jelly roll in a meat loaf pan and bake in a 350°F oven for 1 hour.
Drain off fat and pour reserved tomato sauce on the roll.
Bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes before slicing.
Decorate with tomato slices and green parsley on a serving tray.

_similar.keywords: meat loaf, jelly roll, mozzarella cheese, baked

_similar.name: Surprise Spread
_similar.description: A layered seafood dip with shrimp, cocktail sauce, and cheese.
recipeIngredient: 3 (4 oz) cans small shrimp, rinsed and drained
Tortilla chips or assorted crackers for serving

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the cream cheese, sour cream, and mayonnaise together until smooth.
Spread this mixture in the bottom of a deep pie plate, pizza pan, or shallow baking dish.
Scatter the shrimp over the top.
Cover with the seafood cocktail sauce.
Add layers of mozzarella cheese, green pepper, and green onions.
Top with diced tomatoes if desired.
Chill until ready to serve with tortilla chips or crackers.

_similar.keywords: layered shrimp dip, seafood spread, party dip
